title: Why Manaveeyam Veedhi is at the centre of a political battle between BJP, CPI(M) in Keralam capital
description: The BJP-led Corporation has made clear its intent to make the street 'protest-free' and to keep it limited to cultural activities. Former Mayor and CPI(M) leader V. Sivankutty says the road is under the Public Works department and its management rights have never been transferred to the Corporation
